jobs.title: Data Analyst, Risk
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Google Job 2027 is hiring for Data Analyst, Risk in Hyderabad, India. Check Bachelor’s degree eligibility, SQL/Python skills, and apply online via Google Careers.

New Delhi: Google has officially opened online applications for the Data Analyst, Risk position based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Listed on the official Google Careers portal under Job ID 135283167169782470, this full-time opportunity invites candidates with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent practical experience) and analytical expertise to help protect Google’s global ecosystem from fraud and abuse.

For Indian graduates and data professionals skilled in SQL, Python, R, and statistical methods, this Google Job 2027 listing offers direct exposure to large-scale risk mitigation across products used in over 40 languages. Interested applicants should carefully review the minimum experience requirements below before applying on Google Careers.

About Google and the Risk Analytics Team

Google is a global technology leader building products and platforms that organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible. Within Google, the Risk, Trust, and Safety analytics team comprises analysts, policy specialists, engineers, and program managers dedicated to reducing risk and preventing scaled abuse across Google’s products, protecting users, advertisers, and publishers worldwide.

Working as a Data Analyst, Risk in Hyderabad places you at the center of global trust operations, using quantitative methods and automated detection systems to solve complex security and policy challenges.

Role Details and Responsibilities

According to the official Google Careers listing, selected candidates for the Data Analyst, Risk role in Hyderabad will handle the following core responsibilities:

  • Complex Problem Solving: Analyze and solve intricate risk and trust challenges using rigorous data analysis and statistical methods.
  • Fraud & Abuse Prevention: Identify emerging patterns of fraud, spam, and platform abuse across Google services.
  • Tool & System Optimization: Improve internal detection tools and automated systems through technical data expertise.
  • Stakeholder Reporting: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative findings into clear insights and present recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

Eligibility Criteria of Google Job 2027

Before applying on Google Careers, verify that your profile satisfies both the educational and practical experience benchmarks:

Minimum Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Data Analysis Experience: At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative datasets.
  • Project Management Experience: At least 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Advantage)

  • Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Economics).
  • Programming & Querying: 2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more languages including SQL, R, Python, or C++.
  • Machine Learning Exposure: 2 years of experience or familiarity with machine learning systems.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder alignment.

(Note for Fresh Graduates: While the job requires a Bachelor’s degree, Google classifies this as a mid-level opening requiring 2 years of practical data analysis and project scoping experience. Ensure your resume clearly documents relevant analytical projects or experience before submitting.)

How to Apply for Google Data Analyst, Risk Job (Step-by-Step)

Follow these exact steps to apply safely through Google’s official recruitment portal:

  1. Open the Official Job Listing: Visit the verified Google Careers Data Analyst, Risk Portal.
  2. Sign In: Click the Apply button and sign in using your Google account.
  3. Upload an ATS-Optimized Resume: Attach a clean PDF resume highlighting your Bachelor’s degree, SQL/Python/R expertise, statistical analysis work, and project deliverables.
  4. Complete Application Fields: Enter your educational credentials, work history, and contact information accurately.
  5. Review and Submit: Double-check all details and submit your application early, as Google reviews roles on a rolling basis until filled.

Official Job Apply Link – https://www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results/135283167169782470-data-analyst-risk?location=Hyderabad%20India
